purpose: Finish remaining physical residuals uniformly, without repeating completed solves or tuning reference errors
selection: Existing development states with full Hamiltonian residual above 1e-5 Hartree, in descending residual order
initialization: Recover saved-state Schmidt support together with the input determinant
stopping: Original full residual criterion only; reference-energy errors are not used
completed_cases: Keep already converged He2, BeH2 and continued H4 states without rerunning them
reference_use: Existing labels for final assessment only, never regenerated
limits: Development convergence completion, not a new blind accuracy claim; no speed work
